content: Shang-Chi is getting ready to return to the Marvel Cinematic Universe in Avengers: Doomsday, but fans hoping to see more of the hero have another reason to be optimistic. Dave Callaham, who co-wrote Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings, has confirmed that he's working on a sequel, offering the clearest sign yet that the character's next solo adventure is moving forward.
